about: Mainframe ground-truth ledger (tests/tools/ground_truth_ledger.py). Every engine/forge disagreement with a hand-verified answer key, keyed '<side> | <field> | <program> | <value> | fp|fn' -> cause; every cause has a kind (defect|deliberate) and names its owning issue. CI fails on an unlisted mismatch, a listed one that no longer reproduces, an UNTRIAGED entry, a cause without an issue, or a stale scoreboard. Re-measure with `update`, triage with `assign`.

engine_dead_is_unreferenced_by_name.summary: The engine's usage_status is the unreferenced-by-name census (a unit's name occurs nowhere else in the file), not reachability. Reachability-based dead code stays on the forge by decision (docs/unreferenced_by_name_contract.md; #3348 scope note). Scoring usage_status against the key's reachability verdicts is therefore expected to disagree.

engine_sql_include_same_line.summary: The COBOL import rule is anchored at line start, so a one-line EXEC SQL INCLUDE <member> END-EXEC is never seen and its copybook edge is lost.

forge_copybook_resolution.summary: The forge's fallback copybook resolver misses EXEC SQL INCLUDE members (including DCLGEN .dcl), COPY ... IN <library> (zapp.yaml), quoted COPY 'X' and COPY ... REPLACING. The engine resolves all of these except the one-line INCLUDE (#3416).

forge_flat_schema.summary: cobol_schema_forge's flat reader drops level-01 elementary items, REDEFINES items, some nested items, and lines carrying a change marker in the sequence area (zopeneditor multiroot SAM1). The engine's record_data carries every item; #3348 switches the refractor to it.

forge_hyphen_word_boundary.summary: The forge uses a word boundary before PERFORM / IF / CALL, and that boundary also matches right after a hyphen. So END-PERFORM swallows the next PERFORM, and a live unit reads as dead. END-IF counts as an IF, so a terminal paragraph reads as falling through, and a dead A999 or ABEND-ROUTINE-EXIT reads as live. END-CALL and names ending in -CALL read as calls.

forge_reads_comment_lines.summary: cobol_dag_architect reads column-7 comment lines: commented CALL prose (CALL MENU PROGRAM) becomes a dynamic CALL, and commented SELECT/OPEN become outputs.

header_period_next_line.summary: A paragraph header whose separator period is on the next line (COTRTLIC 2000-SEND-MAP) is not a unit, so its THRU range's -EXIT reads dead in the forge.

program_id_on_its_own_line.summary: PROGRAM-ID. alone on its line with the name on the next: the engine reads a sequence-area token (cols 1-6 of the next line, or cols 73-80); the forge reads cols 73-80.
